exact_question: Under the pinned hillipop-ede_n3 source/configuration, the same fixed admitted common background and matched validated z=810 start state used by Q051, does the actual native CLASS/P6 low-z implementation produce q=xHeII=10^-6 versus q=0 electron-fraction and Thomson-optical-depth histories that are reproducible, trajectory-consistent with the literal source-real dynamics, and contained within Q051's uniform analytic bounds; and what are the realized sup|Delta x_e| and sup|Delta tau_T| with a validated numerical error certificate?
objective: Decide whether the half-q lower barrier has an inward vector field on the first unresolved mixed cell, under frozen source/background/state premises.

contact_face.warning: V87 E=0 factor 1-q/h and its margins do not apply. Include temperature-dependent recombination, photoionization and branch coefficients explicitly.

method: Extract V114 and run python restore_recovery114.py. From the extracted directory run env LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/runtime" python preflight114.py. Require the same binary and backend hashes, loaded path, ABI and rounding tests before counting a face evaluation.

Use V112 as the scientific contract. Inspect the candidate producer and control in calc/ and correct implementation defects before execution under a new run receipt. Factor cancellations with validated interval identities where needed. Hash the final scripts and record the actual loaded library at execution.

Check both common branch pairs and SWIFT/HMLA. HMLA/SWIFT can be excluded by the ordered raw escape at h_L<h_R and common z,H,nH,T_R. Include one-sided fields at the selector threshold and verify strict seed and all applicable phase and temperature premises.

Review draft common-pair normalized lower bound a^2/h_max^2 with a=q/2, U_R>0, alpha_L<=alpha_R and C_L<=C_R. For mixed fields retain both channels and the full Saha subtraction. The old E=0 margin must not transfer.

The deterministic candidate H belongs to an archived H interval. A strictly negative derivative there with separate confirmation tests only that relaxed domain. Fixed-background counterexample status requires H=H_Bstar(z) verified at the same point. A claim about the matched trajectory also requires its joint state admission. A zero-containing enclosure or incomplete domain stays inconclusive.
acceptance_criteria: Strictly positive lower bound for d prime on every admissible face state/branch, independent control agreement, exact full-cell cover, valid seed and all frozen premises. Then conditional half-q continuation through this cell may be claimed.
inconclusive_criteria: Any unresolved branch, zero-containing face enclosure, backend unavailability or resource limit. Preserve precise remaining box and status.
rejection_criteria: Source/pin conflict blocks proof promotion. A validated negative admissible face witness rejects uniform inward-face sufficiency only; actual trajectory crossing requires separate evidence.
stop_condition: One producer and at most one separate check, first failed prerequisite or 300 seconds. Use the original one-cell, 16-slab maximum and no new integrations.
